name: order_bone_marrow_biopsy
description: Orders a bone marrow aspiration and biopsy (typically from posterior iliac crest). Evaluates marrow cellularity, morphology, and architecture for hematologic malignancies, cytopenias, myelodysplasia, and storage disorders.

clinical_indication.description: Clinical reason for bone marrow biopsy

studies_requested.description: Additional studies (flow cytometry, cytogenetics, FISH, molecular, iron stain, special stains)

include_aspirate.description: Whether to include aspiration in addition to core biopsy

when_to_use: Suspected leukemia, lymphoma, or myelodysplastic syndrome
Staging of Hodgkin or non-Hodgkin lymphoma

examples.query: BMB with flow cytometry and cytogenetics
